location.en: Mr. Lin's living room, ground floor
location.zh: 林先生家的客廳，公寓一樓

goal.en: Check the important terms of the lease before you sign it.
goal.zh: 簽名之前，確認租約裡的重要條款。

background: cozy old-fashioned living room with a low wooden coffee table, a few blank sheets of paper and a pen, a teapot with two cups, floral sofa, warm lamp light, afternoon

intro.en: Saturday afternoon. Mr. Lin pours you a cup of tea and slides a thick lease across the table.
intro.zh: 星期六下午。林先生幫你倒了杯茶，把一份厚厚的租約推到你面前。

intro.en: Take your time, Kai. Read everything carefully before you sign.
intro.zh: 慢慢來，凱。簽名前每一條都仔細看清楚。

lines.en: First, there's a security deposit of one month's rent. You pay it before you move in.
lines.zh: 首先，押金是一個月房租，搬進來之前要付。

lines.en: Is that all right with you?

choices.en: That's fine. Will I get the deposit back when I move out?
choices.zh: 沒問題。搬走的時候押金會退給我嗎？
choices.tip: security deposit 是押金，順便問 Will I get it back? 是保護自己的好習慣。

choices.en: One month? Can cheaper a little? I'm only a poor student.
choices.zh: 一個月？可以便宜一點嗎？我只是個窮學生。

lines.en: Can cheaper? You mean a smaller deposit? Sorry, one month is standard.
lines.zh: Can cheaper？你是說押金少一點嗎？抱歉，一個月是標準。

story.en: Mr. Lin spends ten minutes explaining how deposits work in Maple Bay. The deposit stays exactly the same.
story.zh: 林先生花了十分鐘解釋楓灣的押金制度。押金一塊錢都沒少。

fail.why: 「可以便宜一點嗎」直譯成 Can cheaper? 不是完整的英文句子。想商量可以說 Is there any flexibility on the deposit?，但押金通常是固定的，先問 Will I get it back? 更實用。

choices.en: Why do I have to pay so much? Do you think I'll break things?
choices.zh: 為什麼要付那麼多？你覺得我會弄壞東西嗎？

lines.en: It's not personal, Kai. Every tenant pays the same.
lines.zh: 這不是針對你，凱。每個房客都一樣。

story.en: The room goes quiet. Mr. Lin reads the rest of the lease out loud in a very serious voice, like a judge.
story.zh: 客廳突然安靜下來。林先生用非常嚴肅的語氣把剩下的租約唸完，像法官在宣判。

fail.why: 押金是租屋的標準流程，反問 Do you think I'll break things? 聽起來像在懷疑對方針對你。平和地說 That's fine. Will I get the deposit back? 就好。

lines.en: On page two, you reach a sentence: "The tenant shall not sublet the premises." You have no idea what it means.
lines.zh: 翻到第二頁，你看到一句：「The tenant shall not sublet the premises.」你完全看不懂。

lines.en: You look a little lost. Is everything clear so far?
lines.zh: 你看起來有點困惑。到目前為止都清楚嗎？

choices.en: Actually, could you explain this part? What does "sublet" mean?
choices.zh: 其實，可以解釋一下這段嗎？「sublet」是什麼意思？
choices.tip: Could you explain this part? 是看不懂條款時最直接又有禮貌的說法，不懂就問，別硬簽。

choices.en: Yes, yes, it's all very clear. Just tell me where to sign.
choices.zh: 對對，都很清楚。直接告訴我要簽哪裡就好。

lines.en: Are you sure? You were staring at page two for quite a while.
lines.zh: 你確定？你盯著第二頁看了好一陣子。

story.en: Two months later, you let a friend rent your studio while you travel. That is exactly what "sublet" means, and Mr. Lin is not happy.
story.zh: 兩個月後，你出去旅行時把套房租給朋友住。這正是「sublet」的意思，林先生非常不高興。

fail.why: 看不懂卻說 It's all clear，是很多人怕丟臉的習慣，但租約是法律文件，簽了就要負責。不懂就問：Could you explain this part?

choices.en: Sorry, this sentence I see but I don't understand. What meaning?
choices.zh: 抱歉，這句我有看但看不懂。什麼意思？

lines.en: You see it, but... which part don't you understand? The whole page?
lines.zh: 你有看到，但……是哪裡不懂？整頁嗎？

story.en: To be safe, Mr. Lin explains the whole lease, line by line. It takes two hours and three pots of tea.
story.zh: 為了保險起見，林先生把整份租約一行一行解釋給你聽。花了兩個小時，喝掉三壺茶。

fail.why: 「這句我看不懂」照中文語序說成 this sentence I see but I don't understand 很難懂。可以說 I don't quite understand this part. 或 Could you explain this part?

lines.en: Sublet means renting your place to someone else. That's not allowed here.
lines.zh: Sublet 就是把房子轉租給別人，這裡不允許。

lines.en: Last part. The lease is for twelve months. Any questions about that?
lines.zh: 最後一部分。租約是十二個月。這部分有問題嗎？

choices.en: What's the notice period if I need to move out early?
choices.zh: 如果我需要提前搬走，要多久前通知你？
choices.tip: notice period 是「提前通知期」，事先問清楚，萬一要提早搬才不會吃虧。

choices.en: If I will move out early, how long before I must tell you?
choices.zh: 如果我提前搬走，要多久前跟你說？

lines.en: If you will move out? You haven't even moved in yet!
lines.zh: 如果你要搬走？你根本還沒搬進來啊！

story.en: Mr. Lin worries you're already planning to leave. He adds a note to the lease about early-leave fees, "just to be safe."
story.zh: 林先生擔心你已經打算要走，「保險起見」在租約上加註了提前解約的費用。

fail.why: if 條件句裡用現在式表示未來，不用 will：If I move out early...。問提前通知期可以直接說 What's the notice period?

choices.en: Twelve months is too long. I want to leave whenever I want.
choices.zh: 十二個月太長了。我想走的時候就要能走。

lines.en: Whenever you want? Then you need a hotel, not a lease.
lines.zh: 想走就走？那你需要的是飯店，不是租約。

story.en: Mr. Lin closes the folder. "Maybe come back when you're sure," he says, and refills only his own cup.
story.zh: 林先生闔上資料夾。「等你確定了再來吧。」他說完，只幫自己的杯子續了茶。

fail.why: 直接說 I want to leave whenever I want 聽起來像在挑戰房東的規則。想保留彈性，可以問 What's the notice period if I need to move out early?

lines.en: The notice period is two months. Tell me in writing, and you'll get your full deposit back.
lines.zh: 通知期是兩個月。用書面告訴我，押金就會全額退還。

lines.en: If everything looks good, please sign here and write today's date.
lines.zh: 如果都沒問題，請在這裡簽名，寫上今天的日期。

choices.en: Everything looks good. Could I have a copy of the lease, too?
choices.zh: 都沒問題。我也可以拿一份租約副本嗎？
choices.tip: 簽完約記得要一份副本，Could I have a copy? 是合理又有禮貌的要求。

choices.en: OK, I sign. Can you copy one more paper for me to keep at home?
choices.zh: 好，我簽。可以多印一張給我帶回家放嗎？

lines.en: One more paper? Do you need something to write on?
lines.zh: 再一張紙？你需要寫東西的紙嗎？

story.en: Mr. Lin hands you a clean sheet of paper. You go home with a blank page instead of your lease.
story.zh: 林先生遞給你一張乾淨的白紙。你帶回家的不是租約，而是一張白紙。

fail.why: 「多印一張給我」直譯成 copy one more paper 意思不清楚，paper 會被理解成「紙」。要副本就說 Could I have a copy of the lease?

choices.en: Sorry, I didn't bring my personal seal. Can I come back and stamp it?
choices.zh: 抱歉，我沒帶印章。可以改天再來蓋章嗎？

lines.en: Your seal? You just need to sign your name, Kai.
lines.zh: 印章？你只要簽名就好了，凱。

story.en: You insist on coming back with your name stamp. By next week, Mr. Lin has rented the studio to someone who brought a pen.
story.zh: 你堅持要回家拿印章。等到下週，林先生已經把套房租給一個有帶筆的人了。

fail.why: 台灣簽約常用印章，但在楓灣這類英語系國家，合約只要親筆簽名（signature）就有效，不需要印章。直接簽名，再要一份副本：Could I have a copy?

lines.en: Here's your copy, and here are your keys. Welcome to the building, Kai.
lines.zh: 這是你的副本，這是你的鑰匙。歡迎入住，凱。

lines.en: Two shiny keys on a little wooden key ring. They're yours.
lines.zh: 兩把亮晶晶的鑰匙，掛在小小的木頭鑰匙圈上。它們是你的了。

story.en: You signed your first lease in English, and you understood every line. Moving day is next week.
story.zh: 你用英文簽下人生第一份租約，而且每一行都看懂了。下週就是搬家日。

notes.explain: 租屋前先付的保證金，退租時房子沒有損壞就會退還。記得問 Will I get the deposit back?

example.en: The security deposit is one month's rent.

notes.zh: 可以解釋一下這部分嗎？
notes.explain: 看不懂條款時直接指著問，比自己猜意思安全。也可以說 What does this mean?

example.en: Could you explain this part about repairs?
example.zh: 可以解釋一下維修的這部分嗎？

notes.explain: 提前解約或搬走之前，必須提早多久通知房東。常見說法是 give two months' notice。

example.en: I need to give two months' notice before I move out.
example.zh: 我搬走前要提前兩個月通知。

notes.explain: if 條件句表示未來時，if 子句用現在式，不用 will。主要子句才用 will。

example.en: If I move out early, will I lose my deposit?
example.zh: 如果我提前搬走，會拿不回押金嗎？

notes.explain: 台灣簽約常用印章，在楓灣這類英語系國家，合約一律親筆簽名就有效。另外，看不懂就問，不要為了面子說 It's all clear.。

example.zh: 請在這裡簽名並寫上日期。
